channel.title: Los Angeles Times - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Los Angeles Times (latimes.com)

item.title: Officers use floor jack to hoist car off 89-year-old they say was run down, killed by his son
item.description: Robert Porter, 50, was booked on suspicion of murder after he allegedly struck his 89-year-old father with his car, killing him, authorities said.

item.title: Noma chef responds to abuse allegations ahead of pricey L.A. pop-up
item.description: Both chef Rene Redzepi and representatives for Noma say that these allegations reflect the restaurant’s past and not its current state

item.title: After SoCal broils, a break from the summer-like heat is coming. But it won't last long
item.description: Following Saturday's strong Santa Ana winds, Sunday's conditions are expected to remain gusty and warmer. The winds are expected to settle this week.

item.title: Culling the field for California governor? Don't look at me, says Betty Yee
item.description: The Democratic hopeful is ignoring pressure to step aside to keep two Republicans from advancing in the June primary. She sees her straight talk and government know-how as assets once voters focus.

item.title: Nathan Martin wins closest L.A. Marathon in race history, edging Michael Kimani Kamau
item.description: It was a historic photo finish at the L.A. Marathon, with Nathan Martin rallying to beat leader Michael Kimani Kamau by 00.01 seconds Sunday.

item.title: He says Carson councilwoman asked him to mow her lawn and spy on colleague. City disputes his lawsuit
item.description: Former Carson councilwoman aide alleges he was fired for refusing to spy for her and complaining about non-city duties, including mowing her lawn. City attorneys dispute his lawsuit.

item.title: What is Trump's true objective in the Iran war? U.S. targets provide a clue
item.description: The quieter side of the U.S. campaign suggests a political strategy that goes beyond simply containing the Iranian government, and may instead aim to lay the groundwork for its overthrow.

item.title: Gate to Rihanna's home, an RV hit by bullets as suspect fired assault-style rifle, police say
item.description: A woman fired several shots into the Beverly Hills-area home of pop star Rihanna on Sunday, and a round penetrated a wall of the mansion, a law enforcement source told The Times.

item.title: Khamenei's son is selected as Iran's supreme leader; 7th U.S. service member killed
item.description: Trump said last week that Mojtaba Khamenei — the son of the 86-year-old former leader — would be an 'unacceptable' choice to replace his father.
